name: color-grading-skill
role: colour grading / colour correction execution (processing); not decision, not measurement, not automatic look/LUT selection
description: Deterministic colour grading execution: HDR-to-SDR tone mapping, 3D .cube LUT application, colour-tag retagging, Dolby Vision RPU removal, typed primary colour correction (exposure/contrast/saturation/white balance/gamma/lift/gain/levels/curves) and OpenColorIO / ACES colour-space transforms (baked to a 3D LUT by the optional PyOpenColorIO, applied through ffmpeg-skill), executed as a typed operation graph through ffmpeg-skill's public contract, with output validation and provenance. Not an AI agent: it never decides which colour treatment, LUT or look to apply, nor which correction values to use.
not_provided: automatic shot matching (MATCH_CAMERA fits camera B to a reference frame and time the caller names)
automatic white balance (WHITE_BALANCE takes explicit temperature and tint values)

tools.description: Execute a typed ColorProject (operation graph) and write validated video artifacts with provenance
tools.idempotency_hint: content_equivalent; intermediates reused by deterministic operation id
tools.verification: every artifact is probed (video stream, duration, resolution, colour tags measured and checked against the requested operation, sha256); HDR_TO_SDR checks the output is no longer tagged HDR, RETAG checks the exact tag triple, STRIP_DOVI checks the Dolby Vision side data is gone

operations.description: Tone-map HDR (PQ/HLG, BT.2020) to SDR BT.709 (ffmpeg-skill/color --to-sdr)

tonemap.description: tone-mapping curve; when omitted (None), chosen by the input's transfer: mobius for HLG (arib-std-b67), hable for PQ (smpte2084) and anything else; the choice and its rule are recorded as tonemap_selection in results and provenance

peak_nits.description: source peak brightness in nits, used for PQ

force.description: tone-map even if the source is not tagged HDR (treat as PQ)

crf.description: x264 constant rate factor (0=lossless, 51=worst); lower is higher quality / larger file

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to keep, 0-based in file order; matters on a multi-track input (dubbed languages, M&E stems) -- only affects paths that re-encode audio

operations.description: Apply a 3D .cube LUT (ffmpeg-skill/color --lut); LUT is data, resolved and hashed by this skill, never a filter string

lut_path.description: path to a .cube LUT file, resolved through the LUT PathPolicy

lut_strength.description: blend of the LUT result with the original, 0..1 (ffmpeg-skill applies the LUT at full strength for both 0.0 and 1.0; only a value strictly between them blends, see docs/ffmpeg-skill.md)

crf.description: x264 constant rate factor (0=lossless, 51=worst); lower is higher quality / larger file

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to keep, 0-based in file order; matters on a multi-track input (dubbed languages, M&E stems) -- only affects paths that re-encode audio

operations.description: Rewrite colour tags only, no re-encode when the container allows it (ffmpeg-skill/color --retag)

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to keep, 0-based in file order; matters on a multi-track input (dubbed languages, M&E stems) -- only affects paths that re-encode audio

operations.description: Remove the Dolby Vision RPU (profile 8.4 clips), keeping the HLG/HDR10 base layer; stream copy (ffmpeg-skill/color --strip-dovi)

Typed primary colour correction: exposure, contrast, saturation, white balance (temperature + tint), gamma, three-way shadows/highlights (lift/gain), levels and a curves preset (ffmpeg-skill/color --correct, requires ffmpeg-skill >= 0.9.2 for the first five, >= 0.12.3 for the other eight); each parameter is one option of one real ffmpeg filter (exposure / eq / colortemperature / colorbalance / colorlevels / curves), range-checked by ffmpeg-skill itself -- never a filter string

exposure.description: exposure correction in stops; 0 is unchanged

contrast.description: contrast; 1 is unchanged, 0 is flat grey, 2 is double contrast

saturation.description: saturation; 1 is unchanged, 0 is grayscale, 2 is double saturation

temperature.description: white-balance temperature in Kelvin; 6500 is unchanged

gamma.description: master gamma (eq filter's own gamma); 1 is unchanged

lift.description: shadows lift (colorbalance rs/gs/bs, three-way colour correction); 0 is unchanged

gain.description: highlights gain (colorbalance rh/gh/bh, three-way colour correction); 0 is unchanged

levels_in_black.description: colorlevels input black point, 0..255 (8-bit units); 0 is unchanged

levels_in_white.description: colorlevels input white point, 0..255 (8-bit units); 255 is unchanged

levels_out_black.description: colorlevels output black point, 0..255 (8-bit units); 0 is unchanged

levels_out_white.description: colorlevels output white point, 0..255 (8-bit units); 255 is unchanged

curves.description: curves filter built-in preset; None (default) adds no curves term

crf.description: x264 constant rate factor (0=lossless, 51=worst); lower is higher quality / larger file

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to keep, 0-based in file order; matters on a multi-track input (dubbed languages, M&E stems) -- only affects paths that re-encode audio

operations.description: Colour-space conversion named by an OpenColorIO config (the built-in ACES studio / CG configs or a .ocio file): source space -> destination space, or source space -> display / view, with an optional look. PyOpenColorIO (optional extra `ocio`) bakes it to a 3D .cube LUT of the stated size; ffmpeg-skill/color --lut applies it and --retag writes the destination's colour tags (docs/decisions.md ADR-22)

config.description: an OpenColorIO built-in config URI (ocio://studio-config-latest, ocio://cg-config-latest, or a versioned ocio://...-config-v... name) or the path of a .ocio file, resolved through the LUT PathPolicy

source_space.description: colour space of the input pixels, as the config names it (e.g. 'S-Log3 S-Gamut3.Cine', 'ACEScct')

destination_space.description: destination colour space; give this or display + view

display.description: destination display (e.g. 'Rec.1886 Rec.709 - Display'); needs view

view.description: view of the display (e.g. 'ACES 2.0 - SDR 100 nits (Rec.709)'); needs display

look.description: an optional look of the config, applied before the destination

lut_size.description: edge length of the baked 3D LUT; 129 is the size measured within 1/1023 of OpenColorIO's processor for the ACES display transforms on the test chart (ADR-22)

output_tags.description: colour tags the output must carry; derived from a known destination (Rec.1886 Rec.709 -> bt709, Rec.2100-PQ -> bt2020-pq, Rec.2100-HLG -> bt2020-hlg), required for any other destination

crf.description: x264 constant rate factor (0=lossless, 51=worst); lower is higher quality / larger file

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to keep, 0-based in file order; matters on a multi-track input (dubbed languages, M&E stems) -- only affects paths that re-encode audio

operations.description: Soft-clip into broadcast-legal levels: BT.709 legal range (8-bit luma 16-235, chroma 16-240) or the EBU R 103 tolerance, as a 3D .cube LUT over float RGB (super-whites and sub-blacks included) applied by ffmpeg-skill/color --lut (docs/decisions.md ADR-24)

profile.description: bt709: RGB 0..1 (luma 16-235, chroma 16-240); ebu-r103: EBU R 103 tolerance (RGB -5..105 %, luma -1..103 %)

knee.description: where the highlight soft clip starts, as a fraction of the legal RGB span; values below it are unchanged

lut_size.description: edge length of the written 3D LUT

crf.description: x264 constant rate factor (0=lossless, 51=worst); lower is higher quality / larger file

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to keep, 0-based in file order; matters on a multi-track input (dubbed languages, M&E stems) -- only affects paths that re-encode audio

operations.description: Match this camera's colour to a reference camera from a frame pair of the same subject: frames extracted by ffmpeg-skill/look, a correction fitted (per-channel curves or a 3x3 matrix + offset), written as a 3D .cube LUT and applied by ffmpeg-skill/color --lut; the residual CIEDE2000 against the reference is measured before and after (docs/decisions.md ADR-23)

reference_path.description: the reference camera's video (camera A), resolved through the input PathPolicy

reference_at.description: time of the reference frame in the reference video, seconds

at.description: time of the matching frame in this operation's input, seconds

model.description: curves: one monotone curve per channel; matrix: 3x3 matrix + offset (corrects cross-channel differences too)

patches.description: up to 64 stated patches, ';'-separated, each 'x,y,w,h' (the same rectangle in both frames) or 'x,y,w,h/x,y,w,h' (reference / input), fractions of the frame; omitted: the whole frame, which needs the same framing

lut_size.description: edge length of the written 3D LUT

crf.description: x264 constant rate factor (0=lossless, 51=worst); lower is higher quality / larger file

audio_stream.description: which audio stream of the input to keep, 0-based in file order; matters on a multi-track input (dubbed languages, M&E stems) -- only affects paths that re-encode audio

operation_aliases.description: white balance only: PRIMARY_CORRECTION's temperature (Kelvin) and tint, every other correction parameter left at its identity default (ffmpeg-skill/color --correct --temperature --tint)
operation_aliases.resolved_at: validation; plan, identity, results and provenance name the target operation type

mp4.note: must match the source container; this skill does not convert containers

mov.note: must match the source container; this skill does not convert containers

m4v.note: must match the source container; this skill does not convert containers

mkv.note: must match the source container; this skill does not convert containers

lut.note: a LUT is data read by ffmpeg's lut3d filter, never a filter string or executable; path policy applies (allowed_lut_roots)

ocio.execution: PyOpenColorIO evaluates the transform on the cube's nodes only (no media); ffmpeg-skill/color --lut applies the cube, --retag writes the destination's tags when --lut's BT.709 tags are not them
provenance: config (name, profile_version, resolved built-in or file sha256, serialized sha256)
accuracy (max/mean error against OpenColorIO's CPU processor on a test chart, 1/1023 units)
ocio.test_chart: colorchecker24 x 5 exposures + grey ramp (-10..+8 stops), scene-linear Rec.709 encoded into the source space

color_space.note: measurement of input/output colour information is kept separate from the RETAG / HDR_TO_SDR operations that change it (STEP 4 of the design brief)

hdr_sdr.tone_mapping_selection: always an explicit typed parameter (tonemap curve, peak, desat) from the caller; this skill never picks one automatically
hdr_sdr.hdr_detection: measured via ffmpeg-skill/probe (bt2020_or_hdr, or hdr before 2.0: color_transfer/color_primaries); HDR_TO_SDR refuses a non-HDR source unless force is set

rules.request: the request named the curve (always wins)
rules.hlg_default: no curve in the request and the input transfer is HLG (arib-std-b67): mobius
rules.default: no curve in the request and the input transfer is not HLG (PQ smpte2084 or anything else): hable

tonemap.input_transfer: the source's measured color_transfer, through STRIP_DOVI, or the transfer a RETAG writes; after any other operation it is not known up front (null) and the otherwise curve applies
tonemap.recorded_as: tonemap_selection {tonemap, rule, input_transfer} in plan steps, results and provenance; parameters.tonemap holds the curve that ran

alpha.policy: a source with an alpha plane is refused (UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT, reason alpha_not_preserved) for every operation that re-encodes through ffmpeg-skill/color, which writes no alpha; a stream copy keeps it and an output without it fails validation (alpha_lost). Premultiplied / straight alpha handling is not implemented (docs/decisions.md ADR-25)

geometry.changes: no implemented operation changes duration or frame geometry

execution.executable_resolution: ffmpeg-skill directory: --ffmpeg-skill, COLOR_GRADING_FFMPEG_SKILL_DIR, VIDEO_AGENT_FFMPEG_SKILL_DIR, ~/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill, ./vendor/ffmpeg-skill, ../ffmpeg-skill; ffmpeg/ffprobe: PATH lookup by ffmpeg-skill

ffmpeg_skill.compatibility: capability detection, no version window: a checkout of any version is used when every required flag is present in its contract (or --help); doctor reports what was detected (docs/decisions.md ADR-19)
ffmpeg_skill.probe_hdr_key: bt2020_or_hdr when present (ffmpeg-skill >= 2.0), else hdr: BT.2020 primaries or a PQ/HLG transfer either way

provenance.identity: sha256 over canonical JSON of {type, parameters, input identity, tool versions}; a LUT_APPLY identity uses the LUT's sha256, not its path; the source's identity is its file sha256; no timestamps, no UUIDs

per_operation: legalize (LEGALIZE: profile, limits, knee, lut_sha256, out_of_range_share {measured: false, reason})
tonemap_selection (HDR_TO_SDR: tonemap, rule request | hlg_default | default, input_transfer)
provenance_extensions.identity: OCIO_TRANSFORM: the config's serialized sha256 and the baked LUT's sha256; MATCH_CAMERA: the reference video's sha256; LEGALIZE: the LUT's sha256

request_types.note: request.shape lists the 0.4.0 types as an example; every type above is accepted
